obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities must exercise their competences and powers to ensure that testing in real world conditions complies with this Regulation.

Market surveillance authorities must verify compliance with Article 60 as part of their supervisory role for AI regulatory sandboxes when testing in real world conditions is conducted within such sandboxes.
exceptions: Authorities may allow testing in real world conditions by the provider or prospective provider in derogation from the conditions set out in Article 60(4), points (f) and (g).

obligations.summary: Where informed of a serious incident or having grounds to believe conditions of Articles 60 and 61 are not met, market surveillance authorities must take appropriate decisions to suspend, terminate, or require modification of testing in real world conditions.

Market surveillance authorities must indicate in any decision to suspend, terminate, or modify testing in real world conditions, or in any objection issued, the grounds therefor and how the provider or prospective provider may challenge the decision or objection.

Where applicable, market surveillance authorities that have taken a decision to suspend, terminate, or modify testing in real world conditions must communicate the grounds therefor to market surveillance authorities of other Member States in which the AI system has been tested according to the testing plan.
